windows.60: Visitors have raised concerns about the food options at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library, noting limited menu choices and issues with food quality, including bland or poorly prepared items. Some reviews mentioned dissatisfaction with the value for money and the absence of basic offerings like water cups. Service and wait times were also mentioned by a few visitors, suggesting room for improvement in these areas. Overall, while the library experience itself received positive feedback, the food service stands out as an area needing attention.
windows.90: Visitor reviews over the last 90 days show consistent concerns about the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Many found the menu limited and the food quality below expectations, with several mentioning overpriced items and small portions. Service issues were noted, including long wait times and periods when kitchen orders were not being taken. While the library itself receives positive remarks, the cafe’s pricing, menu choices, and operational logistics need attention to improve visitor satisfaction.
